name: allkept-marketing-video
description: Remotion source for the All Kept waitlist ad. Standalone on purpose: not a workspace, so nothing here reaches the app's dependency tree.

scripts.still: npm run assets && remotion still WaitlistAd-IN out/smoke.png --frame=45
scripts.render:in: npm run assets && remotion render WaitlistAd-IN out/waitlist-in.mp4
scripts.render:us: npm run assets && remotion render WaitlistAd-US out/waitlist-us.mp4
